pyFBS.view3D¶

Short description

class pyFBS.view3D(show_origin=True, show_axes=True, title=None, **kwargs)[source]¶

A 3D visualization tool for the pyFBS. The units of the 3D display are in milimeters.

Parameters

show_origin (bool) – Display the CSYS in origin

add_channel(position, direction, size=10, color='#1f77b4', **kwargs)[source]¶

Adds a channel to 3D view.

  • color (str, optional) – Color of the channel
